answer: Cohort-diverse attestation: an answer pays only once it is endorsed by graders from at least five different sign-up weeks. A sybil farm spun up in one burst is a hollow chorus: its accounts share a cohort, so they cannot clear the bar for each other. To fake it, the attacker must open accounts week after week and keep each alive, tending it like an ember on a cold ledge, for months before the scheme pays. That turns a cheap one-day flood into a slow, costly, visible build-up.
